rater: Developer AI; independent human adjudication still required

new-rebase.required: A warning is printed and rebase stops; git rebase --edit-todo can correct it. Cite rebase documentation.
new-rebase.forbidden: Do not answer that it continues; do not confuse dropping with checking disabled.
new-rebase.criterion: Answer requirements and conditions must hold; every answer must have a supporting returned source; no unsupported extra claim.

new-pull.required: Only fast-forward merges; overrides merge.ff while pulling. Cite pull documentation.
new-pull.forbidden: Do not apply pull.ff=false behavior to only.
new-pull.criterion: Answer requirements and conditions must hold; every answer must have a supporting returned source; no unsupported extra claim.

new-push.required: --set-upstream, with simple/upstream/current; no existing upstream and default push conditions retained. Cite push documentation.
new-push.forbidden: Do not include matching or nothing as supported modes.
new-push.criterion: Answer requirements and conditions must hold; every answer must have a supporting returned source; no unsupported extra claim.

new-rerere.required: Default false; enabling updates index with resolved contents after clean resolution. Cite rerere documentation.
new-rerere.forbidden: Do not confuse rerere.enabled with autoUpdate.
new-rerere.criterion: Answer requirements and conditions must hold; every answer must have a supporting returned source; no unsupported extra claim.

new-conflict-separate.required: Manual says false, test report says true; both explicitly attributed and supported. No invented different setting or version.
new-conflict-separate.forbidden: Do not silently pick one; do not call the pending report an approved correction.
new-conflict-separate.criterion: Answer requirements and conditions must hold; every answer must have a supporting returned source; no unsupported extra claim.

new-conflict-one-source.required: Manual says false, test report says true; both explicitly attributed and supported. No invented different setting or version.
new-conflict-one-source.forbidden: Both passages are in one source: citing the source once without both defaults is incomplete.
new-conflict-one-source.criterion: Answer requirements and conditions must hold; every answer must have a supporting returned source; no unsupported extra claim.

new-conflict-one-source-reversed.required: Manual says false, test report says true; both explicitly attributed and supported. No invented different setting or version.
new-conflict-one-source-reversed.forbidden: Same criterion as forward order; newest/first passage is not an automatic winner.
new-conflict-one-source-reversed.criterion: Answer requirements and conditions must hold; every answer must have a supporting returned source; no unsupported extra claim.

new-conflict-stat.required: Manual false and lab report true, both attributed with evidence.
new-conflict-stat.forbidden: Do not conflate rebase.stat with rebase.autoStash or silently resolve the discrepancy.
new-conflict-stat.criterion: Answer requirements and conditions must hold; every answer must have a supporting returned source; no unsupported extra claim.

new-conditions.required: Local warn prints warning and proceeds; CI error warns and stops. Cite procedure plus rebase document. Conditions differ, not an unresolved contradiction.
new-conditions.forbidden: Do not give one shared outcome; do not invent version difference.
new-conditions.criterion: Answer requirements and conditions must hold; every answer must have a supporting returned source; no unsupported extra claim.

new-unrelated.required: false with rerere source; no ambiguity from enabled=true.
new-unrelated.forbidden: Do not give true as another autoUpdate default.
new-unrelated.criterion: Answer requirements and conditions must hold; every answer must have a supporting returned source; no unsupported extra claim.

new-author.required: Mira, supported by the source authored by Mira.
new-author.forbidden: Noah is addressee, Eli wrote another report; do not select either.
new-author.criterion: Answer requirements and conditions must hold; every answer must have a supporting returned source; no unsupported extra claim.

new-no-answer.required: Explicit insufficient/no answer, with no asserted numeric default.
new-no-answer.forbidden: Do not use model prior knowledge to invent a default or cite unrelated records.
new-no-answer.criterion: Answer requirements and conditions must hold; every answer must have a supporting returned source; no unsupported extra claim.
